# Reference implementation licenses

Clones under `third_party/code/`, pinned to the SHAs recorded in
`sources/SOURCES.yaml`. The directory is git-ignored; this file is the
committed record.

**Six repos state no license.** Under default copyright that means all rights
reserved: reading them and running them locally for a Tier-2 comparison is
fine, but their code must NOT be vendored into this repo, copied into
`tests/equivalence/reference_snippets/`, or redistributed. Where PLAN.md
Section 1's obstacle playbook suggests copying a self-contained scoring
function, that option is unavailable for these six.
